Description.Name: Erin Blight
Description.Details: Erin Blight, known by her callsign "Sable", operates within the enigmatic realm of stealth and reconnaissance. Her origins remain murky at best, but she has showcased an unparalleled skillset in infiltrating enemy lines and extracting vital intelligence. For that reason, "Sable" has become a sought-after asset in numerous conflicts across the sector.
